ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #3
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Primary consumers only

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Care PRACTICES.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care PRACTICES.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care PRACTICES.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care PRACTICES.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Toileting PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Toileting PRACTICES.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Toileting PRACTICES.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Toileting PRACTICES.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Toileting PRACTICES.

5. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Heating until a solid melts

6. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Milk souring
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Paper burning to ash

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying People found at home? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to People found at home.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about People found at home.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for People found at home.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on People found at home.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care for PRACTICES be able to;? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care for PRACTICES be able to;.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Our Home? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our Home.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Our Home.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Our Home.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Our Home.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food/ PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Food/ PRACTICES.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food/ PRACTICES.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food/ PRACTICES.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food/ PRACTICES.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Our ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Our ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Our ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Our ENVIRONMENT.

13. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

14. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

15. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 100 °C

16. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. newton (N)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Smell ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Light ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Care For and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Safety In and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Myself ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Our ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
